label: OW04_HTTP8_RACE6_ORCHESTRATION_INDEPENDENT_SOURCE_COUNTER

findings.scenario: HTTP8 completes successfully, then workflow launches race6 in the same bootstrapped Supabase runtime.
findings.expected: race6 receives a fresh aligned AB cp6_rollback clone and runs its own package install, cases, restore and cleanup.
findings.observed_source: The only clone step precedes HTTP8. HTTP8 calls package.run(install), whose finally block force-drops cp6_rollback. The next workflow step invokes race_probe, which also calls package.run(install) and immediately reads the absent ADMIN clone. No clone recreation is present between the two entries. This is a source-predicted runtime refusal, not a Native or CI observation.
findings.bounded_remedy: Recreate the aligned AB cp6_rollback clone between HTTP8 and race6, with a distinct clone evidence prefix. Reuse the existing one-time bootstrap and retain both entry cleanup gates; do not skip package cleanup or relax source/runtime guards.

source_checks.scenario: Missing, duplicate, unexpected or non-PASS race case.
source_checks.observed_source: Import binds declaration tuple to IDS and requires six IDs; strict_rows rejects duplicate planned IDs; final report requires exact case-ID set and counts exactly PASS:6.

source_checks.scenario: Case assertions pass while restoration, advisor disposition, leak cleanup or copy removal fails.
source_checks.observed_source: Race report requires cp6_restored and advisor_gate and zero database_remaining. run_races drops its copy in finally and labels session leaks INCOMPLETE. Outer package additionally requires unchanged primary, backup restore drill, advisor gate and writer_runtime PASS, then asserts all gates to make command failure visible to GitHub.

source_checks.expected: Race step does not run and workflow fails.
source_checks.observed_source: Default GitHub success-conditioned sequential steps apply; package.run asserts writer_runtime status PASS. There is no continue-on-error on either qualification step. The always cleanup/artifact steps remain available.

source_checks.scenario: Disposable HTTP database has no STAFF role.
source_checks.expected: Create an explicitly non-system, unprotected active STAFF master; do not forge an OWNER/ADMIN role or bypass its guard.
source_checks.observed_source: New fixture inserts only STAFF when absent with is_system=false and is_protected=false, refuses an existing inactive STAFF, copies actual OWNER permission keys into STAFF and asserts six required keys. It does not alter role code or Native authorization functions.

source_checks.scenario: STAFF has fine-grained quote permissions but lacks OWNER/ADMIN role.
source_checks.expected: The same real authenticated STAFF can obtain CREDIT quote, while REFUND quote and settlement fail with actual Native 400/P0001 OWNER or ADMIN access required; complete business snapshot stays unchanged.
source_checks.observed_source: Fixture invokes unchanged http.login(STAFF), whose Auth admin create + password grant returns the real access token; positive CREDIT quote asserts both capabilities before exact REFUND denials. The unchanged return_command_access REFUND branch calls erp.require_owner_admin, whose role-code guard still rejects STAFF.

source_checks.scenario: Disposable STAFF role or copied permissions persist after qualification.
source_checks.expected: No surviving fixture database or Auth users; frozen financial and denial oracles unchanged.
source_checks.observed_source: STAFF mutation is confined to the HTTP copy and its existing runner cleanup gates; transport PASS requires zero database_remaining, Auth counts restored and no cleanup failures. HTTP EXPECTED and race RACE_EXPECTED pins match the previously frozen bytes. No backend edits are required by the fixture change.
